description.value: Swans is a landmark Victoria pub and brewery housed in a restored 1913 heritage warehouse at the base of Chinatown, offering 58 beers on tap from their in-house production brewery. The building's exposed brick, industrial beams, and 14-foot ceilings give it a distinct atmosphere unlike most downtown pubs, and the attached 31-room boutique hotel means cyclists can stay the night above the bar. Its downtown location on Store Street puts it within walking distance of the Inner Harbour and a dense cluster of Victoria's dining and cycling routes.
